title: Mohsin and Huma Campus, Peshawar | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Mohsin and Huma Campus, located in Peshawar, Pakistan. Address: University Town. Google Maps location: https://www.google.com/maps?q=33.9952454,71.4090876.
